data.notes: I used all 20 searches. Most values are ADAC data that ADAC labels as manufacturer data; official Audi sources were found only for the A3 8V trunk (launch press) and the A3 e-tron (Audi Technology Portal). Excluded as existing: A3 Sportback 8Y, A4 Avant B9 (2016–2024, which also covers the pre-facelift B9), and A6 Avant C8/C9. Generations returned: A3 Sportback 8P and 8V, A4 Avant B7 and B8, A6 Avant C6, C7 and C7 facelift.

corrections.evidence: Audi 2004 launch material (also reproduced at audiworld.com 'Audi A3 Sportback: Driving Pleasure in a New Guise') gives 370 l, rising to 1,120 l with the rear seatbacks folded, for the pre-facelift Sportback. Autozine also lists 370/1120 l for the 2.0 TFSI. The facelift (2008) is quoted at 370-1,100 l (germancarforum repost of the facelift press release), so 1100 for the facelift variant and generation is fine.
Autoevolution: the 2015 RS 3 Sportback (367 hp) has a cargo volume of 280 L. motor1.com's 2015 test data agrees (280/1120 l). This is not an Audi press source, so confidence is medium.

motor1 test of the RS 3 (2015) with technical data lists a variable cargo volume of up to 1,120 l. Some sites quote 335/1175 l, which appears to be the 2017+ 400 PS facelift or a different measurement, so confidence is medium.

ADAC A4 Avant 2.0 TDI Ambiente quattro (05/12-04/13) and the other quattro facelift entries (241194, 236656): Kofferraumvolumen normal 490 l. auto-data.net gives the same for the 2.0 TDI 190 PS quattro.
ADAC quattro facelift entries: roof-high with the rear bench folded, 1430 l, the same as front-wheel drive.

missing.detail: 8V g-tron: the 2013-2018 g-tron (1.4 TFSI 110 PS, ADAC 8v/238853 and 8v-facelift/257988) is listed by ADAC at 280/1120 l. The 280/1100 l in the data is the 2019 30 g-tron figure. Consider adding year bounds, or a separate variant with 280/1120 for 12/2013-03/2018.
S3 Sportback (8P and 8V) and 8P quattro trunk values are still not found. 8V quattro 340/1180 was not independently re-checked.
S4/RS 4 Avant B7 and B8, and the A4 allroad quattro B8 (2009-2015), are not covered.

C6 facelift (10/2008-2011) Avant length is 4927 mm per auto-data.net and fastcarcheck (vs 4933 pre-facelift). The schema has no separate facelift field; consider a variant-level lengthMm of 4927 for the 2008-2011 variants. allroad quattro C6/C7, S6 and RS 6 Avant are not covered.

verification.notes: Key finding: the A4 Avant B7 trunkFoldedL of 1354 l is CONFIRMED by the manufacturer. Audi Germany's official predecessor-model data sheet (https://www.audi.de/dam/nemo/customer-area/more-information/predecessor-models/a4/pdf/a4avb7/2006_02_a4av_b7_18tquattro.pdf, A4 Avant 1.8 T quattro, 02/2006) gives the VDA luggage volume as 442 l and, with the rear seatback folded and loaded roof-high, 1354 l. ADAC, auto-data.net and autoevolution give 1184 l, which matches the older B6 Avant press figure (Tagesspiegel: 442 l and a maximum of 1184 l) and is likely carried over from B6 or measured differently. Keep 1354. ADAC confirmed the B7 dimensions 4586/1772/1427/2642 mm. One outlier: ADAC lists the 2.5 TDI Avant (11/04-12/05) with a 2648 mm wheelbase. A3 8V e-tron 280/1120 l is confirmed by auto-motor-und-sport. A6 C6/C7/C7-facelift figures are confirmed by ADAC, auto-data.net and vehiclesizes. A3 8V dimensions (4310/1785/1425/2636 mm, 380/1220 l) are confirmed. Used 18 of 20 searches.
